summary: Frontend testing of 2 new features: (1) DailyPracticeWidget on /menu, (2) SeasonalTemple at /seasonal-temple. All 14 test scenarios passed at 100%.
critical_code_review_comments: DailyPracticeWidget: Correctly uses hemisphere='south' hardcoded in MainMenu.jsx. Moon phase, element-of-day, crystal, oracle message and practice CTA all rendering correctly.

SeasonalTemple: Hemisphere auto-detection uses timezone — in non-AU test environments defaults to 'north', which correctly shows Ostara as 'Currently nearest' (March monthIndex=2 matches current month). This is expected behavior.
SeasonalTemple: 8 SABBATS array entries all properly positioned on the wheel using CSS absolute positioning with trigonometry (angle → x/y). All 8 nodes are clickable.
Earth Crafting: 5 EARTH_CRAFTING entries with full step arrays and notes — all rendering correctly in the 3-column grid.
Sabbat modal: 4 tabs (overview/Traditions, ritual/Ritual 🙏, embodiment/Embodiment, nature/Crystals & Herbs) working correctly with tab switching.

All data-testid attributes present: daily-practice-widget, element-of-day, crystal-of-day, oracle-message, practice-cta, wheel-{id}, sabbat-card-{id}, sabbat-modal, close-sabbat, craft-{id}, craft-modal, hemi-south, hemi-north, seasonal-temple.
test_credentials: No login required - all pages are public
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new features fully verified: (1) DailyPracticeWidget on /menu: Southern Hemisphere label, Sunday 22 March 2026, Waxing Crescent moon (🌘 mirrored for south) with GROWTH energy, Fire/Sun's Day element, Amber crystal, italic oracle quote, Breathwork CTA navigating to /breathwork. (2) SeasonalTemple at /seasonal-temple: 8 wheel nodes, Ostara 'Now' badge (North default in test env), hemisphere toggle working (South shows Samhain Apr 30 – May 1), Samhain modal with 4 tabs including Ritual 🙏 with 7 numbered steps, 5 Earth Crafting cards all opening modals with numbered steps and notes, Sacred Temples section on /menu has 4 items (Rose, Elemental, Masculine, Wheel of the Year → /seasonal-temple).
